title: Returns Policy
text:
# Returns
Customers may return unopened products within 30 days of delivery. A receipt or order number is required.

# Refunds
Approved refunds are sent to the original payment method.

title: Shipping Guide
text:
# Delivery
Standard delivery usually takes three to five business days. Express delivery is available in supported regions.

# Tracking
Customers receive a tracking link after dispatch.

title: Account Help
text:
# Passwords
Use the password reset link on the sign-in page. Reset links expire after sixty minutes.

# Contact
Contact support when the account email is no longer accessible.
